title_zh: 人本城市普通人服务链验收契约
title_en: Human City Ordinary-Person Service Journey Acceptance Contract

triggers.name_zh: 断网或数字入口不可用
triggers.name_en: Network outage or unavailable digital entry
triggers.fail_closed_zh: 冻结自动化动作并保留人工/电话/纸面路径
triggers.fail_closed_en: Freeze automated action and preserve staffed, telephone, or paper access

triggers.fail_closed_zh: 改道或停止，不把障碍写成用户责任
triggers.fail_closed_en: Reroute or stop; do not assign the obstruction to the user

triggers.name_zh: 安全事件或 AI 建议无法解释
triggers.name_en: Safety event or unexplained AI recommendation
triggers.fail_closed_zh: 现场人员接管并回到上一个发布门
triggers.fail_closed_en: Hand over to a person and return to the prior release gate

triggers.name_zh: 同意、最小权限或责任边界不清
triggers.name_en: Consent, minimum permission, or accountability is unclear
triggers.fail_closed_zh: 只登记缺口，不调用、不扩展
triggers.fail_closed_en: Register the gap only; do not invoke or expand

steps.visible_service_zh: 公共空间、人工柜台、电话、纸面与 AI 辅助入口
steps.visible_service_en: Public space, staffed counter, telephone, paper, and AI-assisted entry
steps.fail_closed_zh: 没有人工等价入口时停在观察与补资料
steps.fail_closed_en: Stop at observation and data completion without an equivalent human entry

steps.visible_service_zh: 翻译、排队、无障碍导航、技能服务或公共数据咨询
steps.visible_service_en: Translation, queuing, accessible navigation, reskilling, or public-data advice
steps.fail_closed_zh: 权限、同意或责任不清时只登记不调用
steps.fail_closed_en: Register only without invocation when permission, consent, or accountability is unclear

steps.visible_service_zh: 现场人员、电话或纸面服务接回请求
steps.visible_service_en: A staffed, telephone, or paper service takes the request back
steps.fail_closed_zh: 冻结自动化动作，无人接管则停止
steps.fail_closed_en: Freeze automated action and stop when nobody can take over

steps.visible_service_zh: 取消、改道、删除资料、异议和非 AI 解释
steps.visible_service_en: Cancellation, rerouting, data deletion, objection, and a non-AI explanation
steps.fail_closed_zh: 权益受损或无法恢复时撤下场景并回退
steps.fail_closed_en: Withdraw the scene and roll back when rights are harmed or recovery is impossible

steps.visible_service_zh: 复核者回放一条服务链并决定继续、修复或撤回
steps.visible_service_en: A reviewer replays one service chain and decides continue, repair, or withdraw
steps.fail_closed_zh: 证据不可回放或最慢群体变差时不扩展
steps.fail_closed_en: Do not expand when evidence cannot be replayed or the slowest group worsens
